report.title: Emergency Fire Report
report.desc: Submit real-time situational data. This information will be immediately routed to regional emergency dispatch and integrated into the SYLVANIS AI monitoring grid.
report.warning: If you are in immediate danger, evacuate the area immediately and dial local emergency services directly before completing this form.
report.drag_map_instruction: Drag the map to precisely pin the fire's origin point, or use your device's GPS.
report.browse_files: or click to browse device files
report.context_placeholder: Describe the smoke color, direction of spread, or nearby structural threats...
report.loc_unsupported: Geolocation is not supported by this browser.

about.mission_desc: SYLVANIS aims to bridge the gap between orbital intelligence and ground-level action. By synthesizing NASA satellite telemetry with advanced YOLOv11 edge-computing cameras, we detect wildfires before they spiral out of control, saving lives, wildlife, and critical infrastructure.
about.edge_desc: Deploying ultra-fast convolutional neural networks directly to forest watchtowers for instant smoke detection.
about.firms_desc: Pulling thermal anomaly data from MODIS and VIIRS instruments to triangulate high-risk hotspots.
about.community_desc: Crowdsourced mobile reports merged into our situational awareness dashboard for rapid verification.
